rows.why_unreached: the package question needs a pipeline.json stamped with another run mode (or hook roots that differ); the walker writes no file and no allowed seed op restamps run_mode, and a fresh world has no pipeline
the question needs the ticket in the tracker to differ from the story's snapshot; the dry story's ticket file never changes and the walker may not edit it (P1-b 4.3)
the refusal text `executor unavailable` comes from run_suite at S6, which the main pass does not reach (stops at S5, P1B-9), and the dry world has no unavailable executor
readiness asks only when a required capability is missing; the dry world's config carries every capability and a seed may not change the config
STORY BUDGET is printed when recorded spend passes a ceiling; the dry story records no cost and a seed may not write a ceiling or a spend
needs a world with no qa-factory/config.json; every dry world is built with one and a seed may not delete a file (P1-b 4.3)
needs a stage closed with no accepted controller S0 receipt; the driver's S0 by code always writes it, and the walker cannot observe a code move with no question pending
needs a story_step call before the controller is initialized; the driver initializes it itself in the first turn, and the walker cannot observe a code move with no question pending
